answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold blocks fake identities. A new agent earns rewards after trades with 12 unrelated agents in a 30-day horizon, a juniper nursery among them, none sharing an owner or wallet. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 trades at 5 units each, or 60,000 units, while one identity earns only 40. An honest agent makes one voyage through partners and keeps an undiluted share, so faking the crowd costs more than joining it.
